'''Derec''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a crew member of the ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]''. After the ''Jynni's Virtue'' was forced to crash-land near the [[Valley of Golg]], he was killed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by unknown forces. Shortly afterward, Derec's reanimated body returned to attack the ship's surviving crew, having been turned into a [[Korriban zombie]].
